post.description: Registers a new vehicle in the fleet. Requires ADMIN_SYSTEM role.

get.description: Returns paginated users, optionally filtered by role and active status

post.description: Registers the remito and its position assignments atomically, incrementing stock (RN-04/05/06/07).
Registers a request to a supplier. Never affects stock (RN-03).

400.description: Validation failed — field constraints not met

get.description: Returns paginated orders, optionally filtered by status, date range, or assigned vehicle

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled

post.description: Creates a new order and reserves stock. Requires ADMIN_SALES or ADMIN_WAREHOUSE role.

400.description: DESTINATION_AREA_REQUIRED, ITEMS_REQUIRED, PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_STOCK, QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_LIMIT, etc.

post.description: Cancels an order and restores reserved stock. Requires ADMIN_WAREHOUSE or ADMIN_SALES role.

Weighted daily demand and, per active product, whether to restock and how much. Every param is required: each team sends its own business decisions. Inventory position = available (already net of reservations) + on order.

200.description: One row per product, most urgent first

post.description: Computes every active product's restock recommendation with the given params and stores it on the product (product.restock), stamped with calculated_at. Called once a day by the restock-cron service. Filters are not accepted: a run always covers every product, so all recommendations share one calculation time.

200.description: The rows written, most urgent first

post.description: Returns chart-ready series. Rejects unknown or over-broad queries.
Status, battery and an optional error. Faults arrive here too, as `error`, instead of on a separate channel. The id in the path is Infra's; the first reading of an id creates the vehicle.
Infra confirms in_progress (with the vehicle that took the order), completed or cancelled. Repeating the current status is a no-op, so redelivery is safe.

Filters: service (backend|bridge), level (debug|info|warn|error), request_id, text, from, to, limit (default 100, max 500). Range at most 7 days; defaults to the last hour. Lines are newest first; total is the number of returned lines.
Authenticate with email/password and receive a signed JWT token

200.description: Login successful — returns JWT and user info

400.description: MALFORMED_REQUEST — body is not valid JSON

post.description: Returns the URL and key. Requires ADMIN_WAREHOUSE, ADMIN_SALES or SUPERADMIN role.

patch.description: Partial update — only provided fields are changed
Assigns warehouse positions to a reception that is in PENDING_LOCATION status.
Partial update — only provided fields are changed. Requires ADMIN_WAREHOUSE or ADMIN_SALES role.
Partially updates a vehicle's state (status, position, battery, etc.). All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated. Requires ADMIN_SYSTEM role.

Forces an order into the given status (in_progress, completed, or cancelled), simulating the asynchronous transition that would normally arrive via Kafka. Completing an order drains its stock. Reverting to pending is rejected, and orders already completed or cancelled cannot be modified.
Assigns a vehicle to a pending or in-progress order, transitioning it to IN_PROGRESS. Simulates the asynchronous assignment that would normally arrive via Kafka.

get.description: Includes quantity_received_so_far, computed from linked receptions.
Self-describing catalogue: each entity lists its queryable fields, their types and the operators each field permits. Mirrors GET /metrics/catalog.
Returns total stock and the positions where this product is stored
Returns the catalogue categories accepted by the API (RFC sec 3.3)

Self-describing catalogue: each entry carries the dimensions and aggregations a valid query may use, so a client can build a metric picker without further docs. computed_metrics lists the metrics the backend calculates, each with its endpoint and the params it requires.

get.summary: Recent WebSocket events of a feed
get.description: Newest first, at most 200. Feed is one of orders, user-orders, vehicles, stock-alerts.

State (UP|DOWN|UNKNOWN) of backend, bridge, mongodb, redpanda, minio, victoriametrics, victorialogs and otel-collector, probed in parallel. dev is true under the dev or docker profile. uptime_ms is set for the backend only.
SUPERADMIN only. Sorted by path then filename; capped at the first 1000 objects.
